No.8177/2016, On The File Of The Xix Additional Small
Causes Judge, Mact Xli Acmm., (Scch-17), Bengaluru,
Partly Allowing The Claim Petition For Compensation
And Seeking Enhancement Of Compensation.

This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:

Coram: Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Lalitha Kanneganti
 Oral Judgment
This matter is listed before the Court for non-filing of necessary application to bring the legal representatives of deceased respondent No.2.
On 06.01.2025, there was no representation on behalf of the petitioner.
Again when the matter came up on 10.03.2025, even on that day, there was no representation on behalf of the appellant.

Hence, the matter was directed to be listed under the caption 'dismissal'.
2.
Today when the matter came up, there is no representation on behalf of the appellant.
It appears that the appellant is not interested to pursue the matter.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for non- prosecution.

SD/-
